work.name: Nordwind Analytics GmbH
work.summary: Own the ingestion and transformation layer feeding the company's customer-facing reporting product, used by roughly 400 B2B accounts.
highlights: Rebuilt the nightly batch pipeline on Airflow and dbt, cutting the end-to-end run from 6 hours to 40 minutes and removing a recurring class of silent partial-load failures.
Introduced contract tests between the ingestion layer and downstream marts, which brought data incidents reported by the support team down from about 8 per month to under 2.
Mentored two junior engineers through their first year, including code review standards and on-call onboarding.
Migrated 30+ legacy cron jobs into a single orchestrated DAG with alerting and retry semantics.

work.name: Helioform Systems
work.summary: Second engineering hire on a four-person data team supporting logistics operations.
highlights: Designed the warehouse schema (PostgreSQL, later Redshift) that all operational reporting still runs on.
Built a near-real-time Kafka consumer tracking shipment events, replacing a spreadsheet-based process used by the operations team.
Automated the monthly regulatory export, saving roughly two working days of manual effort per month.
